title: personal-llm-inference-mini-tracker-samira-2026
content:
Mini experiment tracker (personal) - goal: quick, scannable table for inference microbenchmarks and tuning notes

Columns: experiment_id, date, model, model_variant, quant, prompts, batch_size, seq_len, tokens_per_sec, p50_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, cost_per_1k_tokens_est, notes, status

Rows:
EXP-2026-01,2026-01-12,redwood-v1-7b,fp16,none,static-1,1,512,480,28,92,$0.045,initial run on dev box (rtx6000),needs better warmup,draft
EXP-2026-02,2026-01-14,redwood-v1-7b,int8,4-bit,static-1,4,512,1700,120,360,$0.012,quantized via q4_0 - cache warmup improves p95,follow-up: try dynamic batching,in_review
EXP-2026-03,2026-01-20,stable-open-13b,fp16,none,chat-like,1,1024,210,38,160,$0.18,high p95 on long seqs - looking at KV cache ineff,open
EXP-2026-04,2026-01-25,redwood-v1-7b,int8,q8_0,prefix-heavy,8,256,4200,22,85,$0.009,best cost/throughput so far,check quality regression vs fp16,draft
EXP-2026-05,2026-02-02,redwood-v1-13b,int8,q4_1,dialogue,2,512,950,52,210,$0.035,latency acceptable on dedicated pool,compare p50 across regions,in_review
EXP-2026-06,2026-02-10,redwood-v1-7b,fp16,none,streaming,1,128,900,18,60,$0.05,streaming overhead measured - client chunk size matters,final

Quick notes / TODOs:
- Add automated script to append results (use simple CSV + timestamp). Want to avoid manual copy/paste.
- Next runs: validate q4_0 vs q8_0 on 13b for convo workloads (focus on quality delta).
- Investigate higher p95 for long sequences: hypothesis is KV cache fragmentation + suboptimal kernel selection when seq_len > 1024.
- Add Column: infra (hosted/dedicated/private) — currently most runs are dev/dedicated.
- Link to longer benchmark harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/benchmarks

Scratch observations (notes to self):
- When running batch_size=8 on q8_0 7b, observed tail-latency spikes when other processes were active on the node. Maybe need to pin GPUs or use cgroups.
- Cost-per-1k estimate is rough: (runtime_sec * gput_cost_hour / tokens_generated) * 1000 — keep it as approximation for quick decisions.

Prompt samples used (short):
- static-1: "Summarize the following text in 3 bullets:
{doc}
"
- chat-like: multi-turn history up to 6 messages, typical ecom assistant queries (10-40 tokens each)
- prefix-heavy: 400 token system + 100 token user prompt - tests KV cache benefits

Experiment shorthand (for my own use):
- fp16 = float16 baseline
- q4_0/q4_1/q8_0 = quant profile names from local quant tool
- tokens_per_sec measured at model output step (excluding network overhead)

Notes about provenance: this is my personal quick-tracker stored in my Drive. For any result that gets promoted to product docs, copy into shared_drives/engineering/serving-runtime/benchmarks and open PR with full harness logs.

Recent action items (Feb 2026):
- 2026-02-18: Push q8_0 7b runs to dedicated pool with pinned CUDA streams (assigned to Jordan Lee).
- 2026-02-20: Run eval prompts to compare quality between fp16 and q4_0 on top 20 user prompts (assigned to Maya Chen).

End of mini-sheet.
